text:
sre-oncall: getting a customer SEV—alert fired but incident-bot didn't page our on-call. alert id 9b7c, severity P1. Not seeing any pages in PagerDuty.
incident-bot: automated: Received alert 9b7c -> creating incident #INC-4821 (status: open). Attempting escalation... ERROR: webhook POST 502 from /pagerflow/escalate
alex: looking at the incident-bot logs now, there's a JSON schema mismatch in the escalation payload. upstream change rolled yesterday to pagerflow auth header format.
emily: confirmed impact — 3 customers reported timeouts in EU region, roughly 2.5 hours of degraded inference. customers_tickets: 4521, 4523, 4524. We should treat as paged incident.
jamie: can someone manually page on-call? /page slo-sre-primary now?
oncall-2: I didn't get anything. I see the alert in our internal tracer but no page. Manually triggered /page worked for me but the bot path is still failing.
alex: paste of failing payload (sanitized):
```
POST /pagerflow/escalate 502
{"alert_id":"9b7c","escalation_policy":"slo-sre-primary","auth":"Bearer null"}
```
alex: looks like auth header ended up null because of a config key rename `PAGERFLOW_TOKEN` -> `PAGERFLOW_AUTH_TOKEN` in deploy yesterday. bot reads the old key.
ops-lead: ack. timeline: alert 2781234500 -> bot tried escalation 2781234520 -> failures observed until manual page at 2781234618. Need immediate mitigation and then rollback or hotfix.
emily: customer impact summary for external comms: 2.5h degraded, ~5% request error rate for affected model shard, no data exfil observed.
jamie: immediate mitigation options: 1) hotfix config to set PAGERFLOW_TOKEN from PAGERFLOW_AUTH_TOKEN (env shim) 2) rollback yesterday deploy 3) add fallback to email page. Which do we do now?
oncall-2: do shim now, manual page is live. I'll stay on call until hotspot clears.
alex: pushing tiny hotfix: setting env shim and restarting incident-bot. command: `kubectl set env deployment/incident-bot PAGERFLOW_TOKEN=$PAGERFLOW_AUTH_TOKEN -n infra && kubectl rollout restart deploy/incident-bot -n infra`
incident-bot: automated: Restart detected. Re-applying pending escalation for incident #INC-4821... POST /pagerflow/escalate 200 -> PagerDuty incident PD-8776 created, paging succeeded. :white_check_mark:
ops-lead: nice. monitor for 15m and then decide rollback vs config-only. add runbook step to detect missing pagerflow auth when token is null.
emily: creating customer-facing summary draft in #support-commms. will include timeline and mitigation.
jamie: creating postmortem ticket PM-982 and assigning to alex + oncall-2 for immediate remediation and to ops-lead for follow-up.
oncall-2: quick note — during the gap we should assume pages might not be reliable. recommend enabling email fallback for critical policies until we have stronger health checks.
alex: adding a lint check in deploy pipeline to fail if `PAGERFLOW_AUTH_TOKEN` exists without alias `PAGERFLOW_TOKEN`. will push PR after this thread.
ops-lead: scope for postmortem: root cause (env rename + missing alias), why smoke tests missed it, pagerflow error handling in bot, detection/alerting for failed escalations, customer impact, and communication timeline.
emily: thanks all. I'll update tickets and post a short incident note in #all-hands tomorrow. :memo:
sre-oncall: closing thread for now — paging restored and customers informed. follow-ups tracked in PM-982 and INC-4821. :zap:
